1851 · Hyde Park

Use Downes for geometry, Routledge for exhibit zoning, and photographs and prints for dressing, colour and camera views.

1852–54 · The move

The 1856 guide describes removal and rebuilding. Construction engravings show methods; exact transport routes and sequences still need evidence.

1854 onward · Sydenham

The 1856 guide adds a floor plan, dimensions and court layouts. Later maps and photographs need dates before they can define the opening scene.

All images were screened in contact sheets; selected pages were examined more closely. Period tags can describe a volume’s subject, including its blank pages. Source dates, dimensions and rights are not blanket approvals. The originals are unchanged.
